title: Say Aturo ya Onsalat
intro: Sakey a too manlapud apalabas iran panaon so akaparaan lan onloob ed awaran. Nen singa agmalinew so dalan tan kinmayat so panduaruwa ed limog na totoo, sayan aripen so pinili ya mangawat na panangigiya. Lapud ambelat so sagradon misyon ed abaga ra, inmarap ira pian mangidaulo ed pasen ya ag-ontutumbok so arum.
clues: Apili ak ya mila ed sakey a propeta tan akaaral ak ed kakabatan da
Inmalagey ak ed arap na Kaban nen asingger lay sipan na Managsustuni tayo, tan anengneng ko ray totoo ya ginmapon nanduaruwa
Pinaalagey ak ed gilig na insipan legan ya maneermen tan manpipikasi ed si Allah so lider mi
Aturo ak ya mangituloy ed sakey a misyon ya inter ed sananey ya akauna nen siak
Naikdan ak na madibinon autoridad ya mangiwanwan ed totoo ed laen da
Tinmalona ak ed impakasumpal ko ed samay ginmapo la antis ko, tan naawat ko so panamaseguro na totoo ed panangigiya ko

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Yusha ibn Nun
Caleb ya anak nen Yefunne
Eldad tan Medad
Propeta Ezekiel (Hizqiyyal)
Propeta Harun (Aaron)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Ag-inmabuloy ya onloob ed insipan a Masanton Dalin
Saray armada nen Faraon ya manguusil ed sikatayo diad dayat
Say panagdayew ed balitok a kilaw a baka
Panduaruwa ed impakadngel ed ganggan na Torah
Say impanrebelde nen Datan tan Abiram
trial.answer: Ag-inmabuloy ya onloob ed insipan a Masanton Dalin

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say lukot na Torah ya inter ed si Musa
Say Kaban na Sipanan ed bakal
Say ibaliw ed Ilog Jordan
Say desierto ed loob na apataplon taon
Imparungtal na Palandey Sinai
location.answer: Say lukot na Torah ya inter ed si Musa

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Say iloob ed insipan a Masanton Dalin
Manggawa na proteksion a padir sumpad saray managlusob
Pangipaalagey na sagradon abung a panagdayewan
Nalelener ed panguusil ed saramay angiburi ed katuaan
Panagbagbag ed saray talintao na sakey a totoon marutak
outcome.answer: Say iloob ed insipan a Masanton Dalin

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
